description.value:
From Survivor · Price: it can make allies fight each other too.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: spread water in a @Template[burst|distance:20]{20-ft burst} within 30 ft for 1 minute. Creatures in it see each other's strength and take –1 to @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} saves against fear and emotion. An enemy that starts its turn in it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} on a critical failure (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates). Also, 1 action: goad a creature within 30 ft with its rival's strength: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}); on a failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1}; on a critical failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} and it must Strike the nearest creature on its next turn.
  • 5: Surge: enemies in the area make a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save or must Strike the nearest creature on their turn (incapacitation): 1 round on a failure, 1 minute on a critical failure. Allies who fail must save too. Your goad can target up to two creatures and deals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[mental]] damage. An enemy that fails its save against the field is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 3} on a critical failure).
  • 9: The area is 30 ft.
  • 13: Allies get +2 to the save. Your goad can target up to three creatures, and a creature that fails against it must also Strike the nearest creature on its next turn.
  • 17: Creatures that fail also continue fighting for 1 minute.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.WRWZwaRtbeHbdQqm]{Effect: Rage Field}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
